utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Please be seated.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. Brdjanin. Can you hear me in a language that you can understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED BRDJANIN
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. I can hear you and understand you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you. You may sit down. General Talic, same question to you. Good morning. Can you hear me in a language that you can understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED TALIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. I can hear you and understand you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. You may sit down. Madam Registrar, you may call the case now, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. This is the case number, IT-99-36-T, the Prosecutor versus Radoslav Brdjanin and Momir Talic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Joanna Korner, assisted by Denise Gustin, case manager. Good morning Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good morning to you. Appearances for Mr. Brdjanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. ACKERMAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, I'm John Ackerman. I appear with Tania Radosavljevic. Good morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good morning to you, Mr. Ackerman. Appearances for General Talic.

utterances.speaker: MR. DE ROUX
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Mr. President. Xavier de Roux, assisted by Natasha Fauveau-Ivanovic and Fabien Masson for General Talic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good morning. Yes, Ms. Korner.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Your Honour, I'm going to ask in a moment to go into private session. But before doing so, can I ask Your Honours to make as a matter of urgency an order that the motion that Mr. Ackerman filed on Friday which was filed openly be made confidential.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Which one are you referring to?

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: The one that was filed I understand -- I hadn't appreciated until after we left court on Friday that it had been filed. It's the one that relates to the humanitarian organisation. I then want to go into private session to discuss this.

utterances.speaker: MR. ACKERMAN
utterances.text: I agree with her request, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Your Honour, the reason that I have to do this is unfortunately we were unable to reach the duty judge over the weekend as his mobile phone wasn't left with security. It needs to be urgent so that nothing -- we've contacted the press office, and we've contacted the Outreach, but it needs to be urgently notified to them that this is not to be released.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So Mr. Ackerman, there is no objection on your part? Yes. The request -- the Prosecution's request motion is being granted, and necessary steps must be taken immediately to notify the Registry with this decision. Shall we go straight into private session now?

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So Madam Registrar, please let's go into private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: 1.44 p.m., to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 19th day of March, 2002, at 9.00 a.m.
